format: Local compact evidence index; repository template unavailable

claim.statement: A prepared GPU-buffer F32 exponent 2.0 reproduces the authenticated upstream connected RMS statistics, precise normalization and BF16 gain bits on the saved S1280 input, including the production-style scalar alias and nontrace normalize kernel.
claim.scope: One saved BF16 block-0 post-attention residual [1,1280,3584] and the authenticated BF16 gain, native precompiled MPSGraph plus Metal; atol=rtol=2e-5 unchanged.

evidence.availability: Local SSD; invalidate on loss/digest mismatch

verification.observed_dod: B five outputs and C three outputs are raw exact upstream; C/B common outputs exact; old square path remains a negative.
verification.native_build: Normal/cpu-only no-codegen, strict Clang, release link, formatting and diff checks pass; exact argv retained.

limits.file_cache_limitation: file-backed bytes are a reclaimability estimate, not guaranteed clean or immediately free memory
limits.limitation: sampled limits cannot prevent between-poll spikes or cover deliberate setsid/setpgid escape
limits.startup_rule: memory_pressure -Q >= 10% and selected headroom >= 10% physical + footprint budget

verification.structural_validation: Local JSON/path whitelist/dereferenced SHA256/report assertions only; no unavailable official packet-validator success claimed.

adversary.scope: Authenticated saved block-0 post-attention BF16 residual [1,1280,3584], connected native RMS/gain and bounded lifecycle only.
adversary.basis: Source inspection, root-executed CPU/build/native guard checks, observed report comparisons, reviewer report/source/launch pin inspection.
strongest_attacks: Extra statistics targets can change fusion: all three statistics producers have only the final +epsilon target.
Observer stores can change normalization: production-style nontrace/in-place arm is independently exact and compared with trace arm.
Legacy failure can hide candidate outcome: per-arm gates separate the retained negative from candidate gates.
Gain metadata is not gain bytes: exact selected BF16 bytes are copied, authenticated against both fixture metadata links and uploaded without shard mapping.
Cleanup must not add a physical wait or release in-flight resources: terminal drain is idempotent and buffers remain retained through completion.
limits: F32 exponent matches effective post-cast operand; Int64 feed/cast topology and closed compiler mechanism are not reproduced.
No production-default change, all-input equivalence, full-block/prefix qualification, or performance claim.
RMS reference trust root is caller supplied and its exact digest is preserved in pinned launch args.
Guard is sampled and file-cache headroom is a reclaimability estimate, not a memory reservation.
Reused companion objects have pinned bytes and opaque prior source ancestry.

refresh.operation: Reauthenticate scoped inputs and build/run pins, rebuild changed source and repeat bounded connected probe under fresh admission.
refresh.failure_policy: Reopen dependent claims without widening tolerances.

next_falsifier: Wire the retained exponent into both RMS sites of an opt-in block plan with accounted shared lifetime/bytes, then separately admit block0 before 26-block prefix.
rollback: Remove new opt-in diagnostic; existing production arithmetic is unchanged.
